propositions: Mirror CI runs on push to main cancel each other and render healthy commits as red X on GitHub, despite gerrit-verify being the actual merge gate
Scheduled 6-hourly CI (not push-triggered) eliminates cancellations by construction, aligning with comparable Gerrit-primary projects that batch post-merge validation
Last-known-green SHA must be resolved from Actions API run history and published with bisect recipe to compensate for loss of per-commit attribution
All six push-to-main workflows must explicitly exclude main from push triggers or drop push entirely, while preserving non-main branch CI and pre-merge Verified gate
Report rendering and run-history lookup move to scripts/main_health_report.py with injected gh Runner for unit testability, never inline YAML
External integration and untouchable workflows (gerrit-verify, reconcilers, reusables) remain unchanged and unaffected by trigger policy shift
